$comment: Documented npm-audit exceptions for scripts/audit.mjs. Each entry suppresses one advisory for the gate while keeping it visible in the report. Add an entry only when a fix does not exist or is infeasible; always record justification and a review trigger. Mirrors the .cargo/audit.toml ignore convention.

exceptions.justification: Memory exhaustion while validating oversized constrained collections. No stable zod 3.x patch exists (3.26.0 is canary-only); zod@4 removes APIs that jdm-editor's bundled dist uses extensively (errorMap, invalid_type_error, nativeEnum, .passthrough(), .merge()), so an override would break the decision editor at runtime. The editor is client-side for authenticated pricer/admin users only; the vulnerable path is reachable via a crafted .jdm import, yielding a browser-tab DoS — no server exposure. Tracked in MPE-123.
exceptions.review: Remove when @gorules/jdm-editor ships fixed transitives (>1.52.0); Dependabot will surface the release.

exceptions.justification: DoS via globparts amplification (CWE-405) in minimatch <11.0.1. Reached only through jdm-editor's spreadsheet machinery; the editor loads client-side (ssr:false) for authenticated pricer/admin users, so worst case is a browser-tab DoS from a crafted glob pattern — no server exposure. Only 11.0.1+ is patched; the dependency tree pins minimatch at majors 3/5/9/10 via glob@7, readdir-glob, and rimraf, so an npm override would force a cross-major replacement on those consumers — the same breakage risk that rules out the zod override. Tracked in MPE-123.
exceptions.review: Remove when @gorules/jdm-editor ships updated transitives (>1.52.0) or minimatch backports a fix to the pinned majors.

exceptions.justification: Prototype pollution in mergeObject(). deepmerge 4.3.1 is the latest release; no patch exists. Dev/test tooling only via jest-config — never bundled into or served by the application.
exceptions.review: On a deepmerge patch release or a jest major bump that drops the dependency.
